$comment: Source of truth for filename conventions of AI-generated documents under the epic-branch workflow. Read by .claude/hooks/enforce-generated-doc-names.js (PreToolUse enforcement) and .claude/scripts/validate-generated-doc-names.js (repo-wide audit). Human-readable mirror: .claude/shared/naming-conventions.md

matching.description: Each convention is considered in scope for a file when its dirGlob matches the file's parent directory. A file is OK for a convention when its basename matches filenamePattern. A file is DRIFT for a convention when its basename matches badPattern but NOT filenamePattern. If no convention classes the file as OK or DRIFT, it is ungoverned and ignored.

conventions.rationale: Stable project-level facts inherit across all epics. Exact filename; lives on main.
Per-epic feature requirements. Exact filename; parent directory identifies the epic.
Per-epic workflow state on the epic/<slug> branch; becomes the frozen historical record on main after merge.

conventions.writtenBy: orchestrator (appended per story commit from developer's Tier-2/3 entries)
conventions.rationale: Per-epic plain-language log. Exact filename; parent directory identifies the epic.

Per-story metadata file (title, summary, ACs, manual-test checklist). Parent directory already identifies the epic — only the story number is in the filename. The slug suffix preserves recognisability in directory listings.

E2E specs live in a flat directory. playwright-runner epic-end mode globs them as web/e2e/epic-<slug>-story-*.spec.ts — both the epic slug and story number are required for batched runs and per-story attribution during fix cycles.
